title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — and the last session an FOMC participant may speak before the June blackout
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 298,899 bytes). The 2027 panel is a hidden tab whose text the rendered page drops, so this session parsed it out of the page's own embedded payload: the US 2027 Memorial Day entry renders as three fields — heading 'Memorial Day', date 'Monday, May 31, 2027', note 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, May 28, 2027'. The same field shape reproduces across the panel's other 2027 US entries (Good Friday 'Friday, March 26, 2027' / early close Thu 03-25; Independence Day 'Monday, July 5, 2027' / early close Fri 07-02; Thanksgiving 'Thursday, November 25, 2027' / early close Fri 11-26; Christmas 'Friday, December 24, 2027' / early close Thu 12-23; New Year's 2027/2028 / early close Fri 12-31), so the note attaches to the holiday it flanks. Presidents Day and MLK 2027 carry NO early-close note on the same list, which is the negative control. Filed estimate on three counts, identical to the sibling sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 entry: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's own press release states verbatim that its closes are 'recommendations only; each member firm should decide for itself whether its fixed income departments remain open for trading' and that 'all SIFMA recommendations are subject to change due to market conditions'
notes: DISCOVERED during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 initial research (2026-09-05), and it is the one operative fact that ledger's leg 6 adds to the gate. WHY THIS SESSION IS DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHER SIFMA EARLY CLOSES ALREADY ON THIS CALENDAR: it is not only a session where the two asset classes keep different hours (equities trade a full session to 16:00 ET — the NYSE publishes no early close for 2027-05-28 — while the recommended fixed-income tape shuts at 14:00 ET), it is also the LAST DAY ANY FOMC PARTICIPANT MAY SPEAK before the June 2027 communications blackout falls at 12:00 a.m. ET Saturday 2027-05-29 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29, estimate). Those two facts compose into a sharper deadline than the calendar shows: on this chair's one clean transmission measurement, Fed risk lands in the front end rather than in equity volatility (fomc-2027-03-17 leg 7, 2y +14bp vs 30y +6bp on the decision), and the front end closes two hours before the equity tape on the very session that is the deadline. So anything waiting on a Fed voice effectively resolves at 14:00 ET on 2027-05-28, and nothing returns until 2027-06-11 — which is itself the BoJ's decision day (boj-decision-2027-06-11, estimate). ESTIMATE WIDENS CAUTION AND LICENSES NOTHING: the underlying blackout date is itself an estimate (a firm Board rule applied to a meeting fomccalendars.htm calls 'tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', so the 2027-04-27/28 meeting is the promotion trigger for both), and a recommended early close is not a market-wide halt. IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped this session for 'holiday|memorial|closure|half-day|early close|blackout': zero hits in both), and the session's own measured behaviour is unremarkable — the pre-Memorial-Day Friday runs 0.556% mean absolute S&P close-to-close move across 21 years (2005-2026 ex-2020) against a 0.698% May baseline, i.e. BELOW it, which the discovering ledger registered as FT-fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29-3 rather than asserting. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'rates' — the closest fit, since SIFMA's recommendation governs US dollar-denominated government, mortgage- and asset-backed, corporate and municipal debt plus secondary money-market trading. SECOND HONEST LIMIT: whether CME's rate futures keep their own separate hours that afternoon is NOT asserted and was not fetched — the same gap the sibling 2027-03-25 entry left open after cmegroup.com 403'd it.
